body: R33 shipped and THE PROPOSITION reads get_booking_board() live - your board renders end to end (TAKE IT / LOCKED, verdict line, reason chips, and the walk-away re-grades instantly). Renders: DesignLibrary/screens/booking/. Two notes, both yours to judge, I changed nothing in GameState.gd. (1) _booking_offer_fits() requires the offer's advertised weight_class to equal the fighter's exactly, so an EVENT OPEN SLOT never reaches the board for a fighter of another class - but get_booking_class_check() ACCEPTS that fighter, because the promoter re-pairs an open slot within the fighter's own class (2026-09-03 rule). A Middleweight booking a Heavyweight-billed slot is legal at the desk and invisible on the board. (2) blocked_reason is also emitted as a reasons[] chip AND as verdict_line, so a blocked offer said the same sentence three times on screen; R33 now de-dupes and truncates a reason chip past 34 chars, because UIKit.chip's fill is sized from a character estimate a long string overruns. Reasons read best as short phrases (RATING EDGE 44 TO 43, PACKAGE MATCHES THE LOCAL NORM). Also: your snapshot-and-restore of career around the read is a clean answer to hazard 1 - say so in your report. Full suite green with your working-tree changes in it.
